_comment: Example agent_env project-registry entry. Copy this to projects/<name>.json (drop the leading _comment fields, JSON has no real comments) and edit the values. Only 'name' and 'repo_root' are strictly required; the rest tune test running, egress/write policy, and the Claude model. Load it with --project <name>.
name: my-project

policy._comment: Egress/write-risk rules, merged on top of the generic secret defaults in agent_env/sensitivity.py. Leave the lists empty to inherit only the built-in secret protections; add your own denies for anything the local/external lanes must never touch.
